name: Balaton Park Circuit
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Motorcycle Circuit (2025-present), 17 turns (7 right, 10 left): the full circuit with Turns 6-7 converted to two doglegs joined by a straight, a chicane replacing the Turn 11 dogleg, and a tighter final sector (Turns 13-15) away from the walls

start_finish.source: Approximate: midpoint of the main straight on OSM way 338856660; OSM has no start/finish node here and 10 m Sentinel-2 imagery cannot show the painted grid

width.status: Published width; no open imagery fine enough to measure edges
